caption.body:
10 product groups America buys from India.

India sells medicines, jewellery, textiles, seafood, chemicals, electronics, machinery, auto parts, rice, spices and handicrafts to the US. Treat this as a research list, not a promise of demand. Check the import data for your exact HS code before you pick a product.

The US has its own labelling and safety rules by product. Confirm them with your customs broker before you quote.

leadmagnet.title: USA Export Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: Pick a product, check the buyer, plan payment

sections.heading: Pick a product
items: Find the HS code of your product
Check US import data for that code
Shortlist 1-2 product lines, not your whole catalogue
Note the labelling and safety rules for your product

sections.heading: Check the buyer
items: Search the company name with the word scam
Prefer secure payment terms for first orders

sections.heading: Before you ship
items: Confirm US import rules with your customs broker
Agree Incoterms and payment terms in writing
